src.title: Brent crude briefly dips below $90 for first time since August on Iran hopes

dossier.headline: Oil's war premium drains as Iran de-escalation hopes grow
dossier.summary: Brent has set the tone for Indian equities since late September, moving with each turn in the West Asia conflict. After a near-13% weekly fall to about $98.32 in the first week of November, it slid again on Monday and Tuesday as traders bet on a US-Iran deal, briefly dipping below $90 for the first time since August before settling near $91.5.
why_it_matters: India imports most of its crude, so the oil price feeds straight into inflation, the rupee and the current account.
Notes repeatedly tie oil moves to the same-day direction of Indian equities, and to which sectors lead.
Oil-marketing and aviation names move inversely to crude; upstream producers move with it.
